cities.name: Al-Qahirah (Cairo)
cities.evidenceClass: official map products and registry descriptions; no bounded target parcel geometry verified
cities.technicalBlocker: No anonymous Cairo parcel feature endpoint or bounded parcel polygon was found. ESA documents the urban real-property registry and historical cadastral sheets, but the current map route remains a formal product request; the governorate viewer is limited to administrative/service maps.
cities.outcome: Official sources confirm relevant cadastral mapping exists, but this pass found no reusable public current feature endpoint or coverage evidence.

cities.name: Alexandria
cities.evidenceClass: official GIS map production and access workflow; no bounded target parcel geometry verified
cities.technicalBlocker: ESA confirms digital GIS mapping for Alexandria Governorate, including planning and state-property inventory, but publishes no feature service; its map sales page describes formal request and purchase. A misleading Alexandria parcel layer was identified as Alexandria, Virginia.
cities.outcome: Detailed official map production is confirmed, while anonymous public parcel access and city coverage remain unverified.

cities.name: Al-Kharṭūm (Khartoum)
cities.evidenceClass: official national spatial portal discovery; linked viewer unavailable
cities.technicalBlocker: Sudan NIC documents a national WMS/WFS spatial portal, but the linked geoportal host could not be fetched. No capabilities, parcel layer, target bbox response, or IDs could be inspected.
cities.outcome: The portal outage is a temporary access limitation, not evidence that Khartoum parcel data are absent.

cities.name: Ādīs Ᾱbeba (Addis Ababa)
cities.evidenceClass: official city cadastre service and registration flow; no bounded target parcel geometry verified
cities.technicalBlocker: The city landholding agency e-Land portal advertises parcel mapping and map-based queries, but its public registration flow requires a name, phone and OTP; no anonymous public layer was exposed.
cities.outcome: The official city cadastre exists, but this pass found no publicly queryable geometry; no registration or account-only data was accessed.

limitations: This is a bounded public-source investigation, not an exhaustive absence claim. No citywide parcel coverage or legal title attribution is established.
